clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 0.5 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 0.5 lakh over the last 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 6 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The OEM must have an average turnover of Rs 6 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder needs 3 years of past experience in same or similar supply.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Bid Details
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover,Compliance of BoQ specification and supporting document
clauses.summary: Sellers must upload experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorisation and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders claiming experience or turnover exemption must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: Arbitration Clause No /Mediation Clause No Bid Details /EMD Detail P /Required No
clauses.summary: No EMD is required for this bid.

clauses.quote: the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: Micro or Small Enterprises are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder itself is MSE OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: OEM turnover relaxation applies only if the bidder itself is an MSE OEM of the offered products.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria subject to quality and technical compliance.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT registered startups are relaxed from the bidder turnover criteria subject to quality and technical compliance.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is DPIIT Registered OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: OEM turnover relaxation for startups applies only if the bidder is a DPIIT registered OEM of the offered products.

clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: Bidder's average turnover over the last three financial years must meet the figure in the bid document.

clauses.quote: No separate documentary evidence is required to be uploaded by the bidder for this criterion, as the system shall derive and validate the turnover figures from the data available on the GeM portal.
clauses.summary: Bidder turnover is validated from GeM portal data and no separate documents are needed.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the required number of financial years.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted proving supply in each required financial year.

clauses.heading: 7. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM's average annual turnover over the last three years must meet the figure in the bid document.

clauses.heading: 7. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Audited balance sheets or a CA/cost accountant certificate of OEM turnover must be uploaded.

clauses.heading: 11. Past Performance
clauses.quote: should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 50% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied 50% of bid quantity of similar products to government or PSU in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 11. Past Performance
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contract copies proving the cumulative supplied quantity in one financial year must be submitted.

clauses.heading: 2 OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS
clauses.quote: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India.
clauses.summary: For imported products, the OEM or its authorised seller must have a registered office in India for after-sales support.
